recipe.name: Tropical Ananas
recipe.description: A sweet, fruity mocktail of pineapple and orange with muddled strawberry and a fresh note of thyme.
steps: Muddle the strawberries with one thyme sprig in a shaker.
Add the pineapple and orange juice and shake with ice.
Double strain into an ice-filled rocks glass.
recipe.ice: Shaken with ice; served over fresh ice
recipe.garnish: The second thyme sprig and half a strawberry
